verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships in-product AI that works on customer data. First Pass AI pre-screens uploaded evidence to catch likely auditor rejections, and GenAI DDQ autofills questionnaires from a library of previous questionnaires. These are narrow, task-specific uses, and the AI Helpbot answers only from Thoropass documentation, not the user's data. missing for 10: general AI-generated insights or recommendations across workspace data (risks, controls, monitors), documented detail on what First Pass AI's feedback looks like, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: First Pass AI pre-screens evidence before the audit, eliminating the bottlenecks between evidence collection and auditor acceptance
Eliminate manual QA and common evidence rejections by pre-screening evidence for audit in seconds.
